description: SKETCH3D Canonical Visual & Geometric Ground-Truth Benchmarks for VLM and Multi-Angle Orbit Verification

quadrant_inspection_rubric.isometric: Continuous 360-degree cylindrical shell with uniform helical ribbon relief on outer surface.
quadrant_inspection_rubric.top_cavity: Strictly concentric inner hollow cavity (circle r=23.4mm) with zero wall bleed or interior ripples.
quadrant_inspection_rubric.front: Level horizontal base, vertical outer ribs rising uniformly without pinch or axis skew.
quadrant_inspection_rubric.rear_back: Seamless 360-degree closure at theta=PI with zero seam cleft, facet gaps, or missing faces.

bauble.name: Christmas Bauble Ornament (Spherical Revolve + Spiral Bulb)

quadrant_inspection_rubric.isometric: Smooth bulbous spherical curvature with spiral ribbons tapering gracefully at both poles.
quadrant_inspection_rubric.top_cavity: Open neck collar for ornament cap/hook attachment, clean rim without non-manifold singularities.
quadrant_inspection_rubric.front: Symmetrical bulb silhouette with smooth overhang angle transitions suitable for support-free vase printing.
quadrant_inspection_rubric.rear_back: Identical back curvature and ribbon alignment confirming axis symmetry.

tree.name: Multi-Tiered Christmas Tree (Stepped Lathe Overhangs + Wave Needle Ridges)

quadrant_inspection_rubric.isometric: Conical tiered silhouette with distinct shelf steps and wave surface needle texture.
quadrant_inspection_rubric.top_cavity: Centered apex needle tip terminating on revolve axis without vertex explosion.
quadrant_inspection_rubric.front: Tiered steps clearly defined, overhang angles <= 55 degrees ensuring FDM printability.
quadrant_inspection_rubric.rear_back: Complete 360-degree concentricity across all 4 branch tiers.

cube.name: Precision Cube with Hardware Pocket & Bore (CSG Boolean Engine)

quadrant_inspection_rubric.isometric: Crisp 40mm cube with clearly cut central bore and recessed hex nut pocket.
quadrant_inspection_rubric.top_cavity: Sharp hexagonal flat-to-flat pocket walls matching M4 hardware tolerance.
quadrant_inspection_rubric.front: Cylindrical through-bore penetrating cleanly through bottom face without residual thin membranes.
quadrant_inspection_rubric.rear_back: Solid flat rear and side faces free from degenerate triangles or self-intersections.
